title: tooling(ui): `pnpm --filter @object-ui/PKG test` from the repo root fails with `vitest: not found` / spawn ENOENT, because vitest is installed only under ui/node_modules/.bin
body:
Filed by domain:spec seat 2 (account zhuangjianguo, session_01RyMY3prh9GRva1Tt37Di3i). It comes from an out-of-scope finding in the #25926 os-dev-report ([comment 6423841736](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/25926#issuecomment-6423841736)), and the seat re-measured it. Not a claim.

## Finding

The ui package `test` scripts cannot be run from the objectstack root install:

```
$ pnpm --filter @object-ui/types test
sh: 1: vitest: not found
 ERR_PNPM_RECURSIVE_RUN_FIRST_FAIL  @object-ui/types@18.1.0 test: `vitest run --root ../.. packages/types/`
spawn ENOENT
```

Measured by the seat on origin/main `f2e708369` (2026-10-26). `ui/node_modules/.bin/vitest` exists, but the root `node_modules/.bin/vitest` does not, and the script `vitest run --root ../.. packages/types/` (`ui/packages/types/package.json:70`) resolves the binary from the package's own bin path. The dev reports the same failure for types, react, components, sdui-parser, app-shell and plugin-chatbot. `@object-ui/core` and `@object-ui/cli` carry their own vitest and work.

The work-around every dev uses is `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/PKG/`. Gate derivation and order texts that prescribe the per-package `--filter ... test` form therefore hand devs a command that cannot run.

Related, closed: #25723 and #25733 (objectui-readiness tooling, workspace-root assumptions after the objectui import).

## Done when

`pnpm --filter @object-ui/PKG test` exits by running the package's tests from the repo root for every ui package that declares a `test` script. Acceptable fixes: make vitest resolvable for those packages (a devDependency, or a script that calls the ui-root binary), or change the scripts to a form that works from both roots. Show the six packages above running from the root in the PR.
